text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5. UIBE application form (Printed out from online application system) 6.A copy of TOEFL/IELTS or certification from the institution awarding your most recent degree to confirm the language of instruction is English
